measurementRules.rule: First release is after all same-configuration required fitting, assembly, checks, rework and required supply packing, ready for supply at the plant. Q_c (also Q0_c) is the independently weighed sum of unique first accepted complete-frame net masses, excluding packaging tare and including actual matched loose parts. Original product composition, water state and acceptance IDs are locked before reconciliation. Initial required packing belongs to new manufacture; later storage, repacking, redelivery, repair and retest are only real service of the original cohort in H and never a second acceptance. Reopening or failed work does not erase previous loads. A count-to-kg bridge uses independently measured actual same-configuration net mass; no default piece weight/density.

Convert real raw units before attribution. kWh ×3.6 gives MJ once; tonnes ×1000 gives kg. Integrate only a true rate over actual time; an integrated volume is already extensive. Volume-to-mass needs independent same-substance phase/T/P density; secondary flow factors do not provide it. Item and Item(s) denote the same count unit with factor1 but imply no kg conversion.

Collect raw quantities without division. single_quotient is the only normalization: selected burden A or full gross V divided by original cohort Q_c once. Reference first_release remains1kg. Closing already released FG is already included in Q_c. Q_c=0 preserves every actual load and produces no unit result.

calculationRules.rule: Convert original extensive units and true rates before any attribution; kWh ×3.6 to MJ once and tonnes ×1000 to kg. Count/volume conversions need independently measured same-configuration net mass or same-substance state density. Preserve whole-preparation/component/water bridges disjoint.

For each burden dimension e, A_e = B_open,e + U_e - B_close,e - T_other,e after convert_raw and justified exclusive/causal/residual attribution. Maintain each inherited raw/WIP/non-WIP vector. Exclude released FG from B_close; retain failure/test/cleanup/rework/waste/treatment loads and actual zero-output events. T_other is a proven one-time other-cohort/function handover, never an unexplained subtraction. No second correction to stock-corrected values.
calculationRules.output: manufacturing A_e bound to release cohort

calculationRules.rule: For each original cohort c and actual H, service A_e,c = opening unused/unassigned service vector + actual incremental service - closing unused/unassigned service vector - proven independent handover. Keep original Q_c, prior burden genealogy and all performed service even when FG remains or dispatch is zero. No subtraction of already performed service due to closing FG; no assumed future work or repeat Q.

Every physical event dimension uses full actual converted V_e on its own leg: component/FG return and shipment, all packaging events, assets, fluids, Waste and molecular species. Never use A, stock differences, consumption, economic/service shares or a burden vector for these physical numerators. A gross event creates no second purchase, treatment or credit; bridge one separate burden owner where real. X only deduplicates a same-side OTHER flow already represented, never stocks/opposite legs/card existence.

The sole normalization is reported quantity = selected numerator / Q_c once. Select match_manufacture A_e for manufacture burden, match_service A_e,c for observed service burden, or select_gross full V_e for physical events; preserve separate dimensions/one owner. Q_c is original newly first-released complete-frame net kg. first_release is1kg. All cards and aggregation reference this same result with no further division. Q_c=0 retains every actual load and genealogy for later justified attribution and produces no unit result.
calculationRules.output: one per reference flow report with distinct physical and burden dimensions

calculationRules.rule: For each actual polyethylene-bag or corrugated-carton whole wet pool in kg, verify O + P + I + ERin + J_in + H2O_in - X_in = C + S + EOout + W + J_out + H2O_out - X_out. O/C include empty, WIP-attached, FG-attached, returned and reusable physical stocks; P is fresh purchase, I real supplier-included receipt, ERin external return received inward, S gross shipment outward, EOout external return sent outward, and W the actual whole wet waste exit. Paired internal reuse cancels on consolidation; it is neither ERin nor EOout nor procurement. Actual supplier-included packaging has one complete upstream owner and is never bought again. J_in/J_out are independently evidenced disjoint additional non-water transfers such as actual retained repair material, dust or oil only where not already included in another whole gross leg. H2O_in/H2O_out are actual sorption/addition/evaporation or other water transfers not already contained in a wet leg. Closing C retains all true additions even without repair. X_in/X_out subtract only proved overlap between OTHER same-side flow observations; never real J/H2O, C, opposite directions, unknown closure differences or card existence. Unknown terms are not fitted. Trace each true increment to its physical source/receiver and specific atomic interface; paired internal J/water is not a new provider or waste exit. Nested water/material in a gross wet leg is counted once. Independently reconcile manufacturing, FG/service and combined full wet physical gates as well; pair/cancel internal first-release and reuse transfers, and never treat reference events as extra external exits.
calculationRules.output: manufacturing and FG/service and combined physical closure reports

calculationRules.rule: Independently verify Q0_c = D0_c + FG0_c + Held0_c + L0_c + T0_c, with disjoint remaining original-material deliveries, released on-site FG, every other actual accepted on-site state, irreversible original material/water losses, and other terminal dispositions. Subdivide those bins for every real location/status; gross delivery/return loops cancel only in this event bridge. Record each original-material fate once on its locked acceptance basis. Independently bridge each surviving present wet mass to original matter still present plus real retained later non-water material and water changes. Do not restore a lost original mass into a survivor and also retain it in L0_c. New material/sorbed water creates physical mass, not new Q. Q0_c=0 or unknown retains all raw loads and no normalized result.
calculationRules.output: original Q0 and independently reconciled wet physical states

calculationRules.rule: For each actual contaminated wipe, bag, carton, offcut, rejected frame, pneumatic condensate, wastewater or retired whole tool/equipment stream, record one complete receiver event Qt with substrate, retained steel/plastic/oil/dust/other residue and water once. Origin/assay components are nested nonadditive ledgers until actually separated before export. The real provider receives the full physical Qt in its compatible unit once. Separately identify the total actual modelling-service demand and nonoverlapping A_e,c for every serviced original cohort Q0_c (or actual new-manufacture Q_c), including failed work and original history. A share changes attributed service/burden, never the actual receiver mass. Unknown assignment remains unresolved; neither charge Qt again to each cohort nor shrink its physical exit.
calculationRules.output: full physical Qt and separate nonoverlap compatible A_e,c

measurementRules.rule: 首次放行位于同配置所需配合修整、装配、检验、返工及必要供货包装全部完成、工厂可供货之时。Q_c（亦记Q0_c）为唯一首次验收完整伞架独立实测净质量之和，排除包材皮重，包含实际齐套散装部件。先锁定原产品组成、水状态及验收ID再对账。首次必要包装归新增制造；后续留库、重包装、再交付、修理和复检仅是观察期H原队列真实服务，不产生第二验收。重开或失败作业不抹去既往负荷。 件数转kg仅用实际独立实测同配置净质量，不猜件重/密度。
先转换真实原始单位再归属；kWh ×3.6 仅一次转 MJ，公吨 ×1000 转 kg。只有真实速率按实测时间积分，已积分体积已是广延量。体积转质量须独立同物质相态/T/P 密度，次级流因子不能提供。item 与 Item(s) 同为件数单位因子1，不蕴含 kg 换算。
采集未除原始量，single_quotient 是唯一归一化：所选负荷 A 或完整 gross V 除原批次 Q_c 一次。参考 first_release 保持1千克。期末已放行 FG 已含于 Q_c；Q_c=0 保留全部实际负荷且不生成单位结果。

calculationRules.rule: 任何归属前转换原始广延单位及真实速率；kWh ×3.6 仅一次转 MJ，公吨 ×1000 转 kg。件数/体积换算须独立实测同配置净质量或同物质状态密度；整份制剂/部件/水桥互斥。
各负荷维度 e 在 convert_raw 及合理专属/因果/剩余归属后，A_e = B_open,e + U_e - B_close,e - T_other,e。逐原料/WIP/非WIP保留继承向量。B_close 不含已放行 FG，保留失败/试验/清理/返工/废物/处理及真实零产出。T_other 仅为已证一次其他批次/功能交接，不是不明扣减；已作库存修正的量不再修正。
calculationRules.output: 绑定放行批次的制造 A_e

calculationRules.rule: 各原批次 c 和实际 H，服务 A_e,c = 期初未用/未分配服务向量 + 实际增量服务 - 期末未用/未分配向量 - 已证独立交接。保留原 Q_c、既往负荷谱系及全部已执行服务，即使 FG 留库或零发运；不因期末 FG 扣已执行服务，不假定未来作业或重复 Q。
每项实物事件维度使用本腿全部实际转换 V_e，涵盖部件/FG 退回及发运、各包装事件、资产、流体、Waste 和分子物种。物理分子不能用 A、库存差、消耗量、经济/服务份额或负荷向量。gross 事件不创造第二采购/处理/抵扣，真实负荷另桥到唯一所有者；X 只去重同侧 OTHER 已表示流，不冲库存/对侧/卡存在。

唯一归一化为报告数量 = 所选分子 / Q_c 一次。制造负荷取 match_manufacture A_e，观察期服务负荷取 match_service A_e,c，实物事件取 select_gross 全部 V_e；保留不同维度/唯一所有权。Q_c 为原批次完整净伞架首次新增放行 kg；first_release 为1千克。所有卡及聚合引用同一次结果，不再除。Q_c=0 保留所有实际负荷及谱系以供后续合理归属，不生成单位结果。
calculationRules.output: 每参考流一次报告，实物/负荷维度分开

calculationRules.rule: 每个实际聚乙烯袋或瓦楞纸箱整湿池以kg核对O + P + I + ERin + J_in + H2O_in - X_in = C + S + EOout + W + J_out + H2O_out - X_out。O/C包含空包、附着WIP、附着FG、退回及复用实物库存；P为新增采购，I为真实供应商已含接收，ERin为外部退回收进，S为gross对外发运，EOout为对外退还，W为实际整湿废物出口。内部复用配对在合并时抵消，不是ERin、EOout或采购。供应商已含包装具有一个完整上游所有者，不再购买一次。 J_in/J_out为独立实证且互不重叠的额外非水转移，例如真实留存修理料、粉尘或油，仅限尚未包含于其他整gross腿的部分。H2O_in/H2O_out为实际吸湿/加水/蒸发或其他未包含于整湿腿的水转移。期末C保留全部真实增量，即使没有修理。X_in/X_out仅扣OTHER同侧流观测间已证重叠，不扣真实J/H2O、C、反向流、未知闭合差或卡片存在。未知项不拟合。真实增量追到物理来源/接收方及具体原子接口；配对内部J/水不是新增provider或废物出口。gross湿腿内含的水/物料只计一次。 制造、FG服务及合并完整湿实物门另独立核对；内部首次放行及复用交接配对抵消，参考事件不是新增外部出口。
calculationRules.output: 制造/FG服务/合并实物闭合报告

calculationRules.rule: 独立核对Q0_c = D0_c + FG0_c + Held0_c + L0_c + T0_c，各项分别为互不重叠的尚存原物料交付、现场已放行FG、全部其他实际现场已验收状态、原物料/水不可逆损失和其他终端去向。按每个真实地点/状态继续细分；gross交付/退回循环仅在此事件桥中抵消。各原物料去向在锁定验收基准下仅记一次。另将各幸存制品当前湿质量桥接到仍在其中的原物料以及后续真实留存非水物料和水变化。不将原损失恢复进幸存物后又记入L0_c。新料/吸湿增加实物质量，不增加Q。Q0_c=0或未知保留全部原始负荷且无归一化结果。

calculationRules.rule: 每个实际污染擦布、袋、纸箱、边角料、报废伞架、气路冷凝液、废水或退役整工具/设备流，记录一次完整接收事件Qt，包含基材、留存钢/塑料/油/尘/其他残留及水一次。来源/检验组分仅为嵌套非加和账，除非出口前真实分离。真实provider按兼容单位一次接收全部实物Qt。另识别实际建模服务总需求及每个受服务原队列Q0_c（或真实新增制造Q_c）互不重叠A_e,c，包含失败作业及原历史。份额只改变服务/负荷归属，不改变真实接收质量。未知归属保持未解，不向各队列重复计Qt，也不缩小实物出口。
calculationRules.output: full physical Qt and separate nonoverlap compatible A_e,c

collectionProtocols.collection_method: 逐包装称量并完整核对事件/库存，PE 袋与纸箱分池；gross 实物腿不乘负荷份额，整件材料层仅含一次；新增实际包装另列原子池/卡。 每个实际聚乙烯袋或瓦楞纸箱整湿池以kg核对O + P + I + ERin + J_in + H2O_in - X_in = C + S + EOout + W + J_out + H2O_out - X_out。O/C包含空包、附着WIP、附着FG、退回及复用实物库存；P为新增采购，I为真实供应商已含接收，ERin为外部退回收进，S为gross对外发运，EOout为对外退还，W为实际整湿废物出口。内部复用配对在合并时抵消，不是ERin、EOout或采购。供应商已含包装具有一个完整上游所有者，不再购买一次。 J_in/J_out为独立实证且互不重叠的额外非水转移，例如真实留存修理料、粉尘或油，仅限尚未包含于其他整gross腿的部分。H2O_in/H2O_out为实际吸湿/加水/蒸发或其他未包含于整湿腿的水转移。期末C保留全部真实增量，即使没有修理。X_in/X_out仅扣OTHER同侧流观测间已证重叠，不扣真实J/H2O、C、反向流、未知闭合差或卡片存在。未知项不拟合。真实增量追到物理来源/接收方及具体原子接口；配对内部J/水不是新增provider或废物出口。gross湿腿内含的水/物料只计一次。

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 核对完整原生名/同义词/备注/CAS、牌号、路线、形态/相态、地理、介质、类型和所有属性。精确参考属性版本绑定精确单位组版本及实际参考单位，不用 latest 替代或次级密度推断。每卡及规范上下文保留完整采用限制；硬冲突阻止该身份，分类瑕疵单独披露。
原取得及本次复用/提取分别溯源；片段按产品/过程/路线/状态/need 请求读取。read 成功或 fragment_verified 本身不证明适用性/数字复用。保留相邻反例和全部失败，不编造历史。

产品及路线有定性支持，不是实测工厂LCI，也不迁移目录限值。实际等级/涂层/滑套材料/provider、尺寸、数量及批次QA仍需前景记录；缺少这些观测本身不抹去已建立的称量、计量、机械检验或分配方法。按测量对象保留真实校准、回收、检出/定量限及不确定性。气动空气须记录独立实测湿进/排气、状态及每个实际物种、冷凝液和润滑油出口。不假定恒定大气组成，不从COD推油/VOC物种，不强守恒反应物种，不以一个闭合残差求多个未知。真正未建立的必要物种/基质程序对受影响主张保持具体hold，未来SOP、有限检查通过或QA未执行均不能豁免。
